title: Recipe Book is Pain
description: Makes the recipe book use creative tabs for groups
body:
# Recipe Book is Pain

[![Follow on Bluesky!](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zenfyrdev/mini-badges/v1/social/bluesky/follow.svg)](https://bsky.app/profile/did:plc:udgxgv72u6qheiwgwfahqylp)
***

Makes the recipe book use creative tabs for groups, making it a bit more useful in modpacks.

Also adds Group Pages to support a lot more tabs.

![showcase of the mod](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/constellation-mc/rbip/1.20.1-fabric/images/showcase.webp)

***

FAQ:

- Do I need to install Fabric API alongside this mod?

Yes, since v1.0.0 Fabric API is required

- Is mod "X" supported?

Most likely, Yes, unless mod "X" doesn't add its items to the creative menu or there's a compatibility edge case.
